title: NBA: OKC's Holmgren to miss at least 8 weeks as Thunder injury woes deepen
summary: Oklahoma City big man Chet Holmgren will miss eight to 10 weeks with a knee tendon tear, the NBA team said Friday, the latest injury blow for the 2025 champions.
